_readme: Hand-written relations between the platform's six territories, 2026-09-10. All six sit on the group rung, so these are horizontal; each carries a source and a falsifier and passes the same validator as an API-created relation.

shapes.sh_upstream_bounds_downstream: What an earlier stage lets through bounds what a later stage can do with it.

relations.note: What is perceived is what can be known: no tag, link or entity exists that some intake path did not first let in.
relations.falsifier: A knowledge row with no intake path behind it — not seeded, not mined, not written by hand — would break this.

relations.note: Reasoning works over the graph knowledge holds: echoes, loops and anatomies can only be computed from relations and tags already written down.
relations.falsifier: A computed echo or loop resting on no stored tag or relation would break this.
